description:
V00.74 declarative token-propagation runtime: PropagatingProxy
    runtime path, PropagationDiagnosticContributor, and the
    PropagateTokenAdvisor.Default wiring consumers depend on. The
    matching compile-time wrapper lives in
    jCustos-propagation-processor; OIDC strategies (RFC 8693 / 6749
    §4.4) ship in the opt-in jCustos-propagation-oidc module.
